extras.real_size: mine cart (mine tub), 1.5 m long, 0.95 m wide, 1.27 m high with the ore load and track, on a 2.4 m narrow gauge track piece (gauge 600 mm)
extras.notes: front faces -Y. Narrow gauge track like the Cozy Wild West mine entrance: wooden sleepers 1.0 x 0.14 x 0.08 m on the ground, rail heads at x = -0.325 and +0.325, rail top 0.1675 m; track ends at y = -1.2 and +1.2. Red flared tub with rolled rim, iron bands and rivets, open top with a heap of grey ore and golden nuggets, two wheelsets, wooden bumpers and chain couplings; the cart stands on the rail top; wheels and load are part of the mesh (no moving parts)

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
